title_en: Chinese History (8/20): Zheng He Sails the Western Oceans
note_en: In a Chinese comparison, the amount of difference comes after the adjective: 比欧洲的大航海时代还要早了将近一百年 is literally "than Europe's Age of Discovery even earlier by nearly a hundred years." English puts the amount first ("nearly a hundred years earlier"), but Chinese says A 比 B + adjective + amount, and 还要 adds the sense of "even."
